input_images.role: structural identity and real photographic base
existing homepage layout, palette and original meaning

notes: All variants are AI creative composites based on the supplied real photograph. Added wind farms and supporting infrastructure are conceptual composition elements, not a claim about the station's actual surroundings.
Website context reuses existing frontend markup and CSS without running application APIs.
Production homepage files have not been changed by this review.

variants.title: 深蓝 · 旗舰
variants.prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing. Asset: high-end photorealistic art image for the RIGHT SIDE of a Chinese ocean-energy research website homepage. Reference image 1 is the user's REAL photograph of CNOOC's 深海一号 / Shenhai No.1 energy station: it is the subject and structural identity reference. Reference image 2 is the existing homepage screenshot: use ONLY to coordinate deep navy/teal colors, compositional restraint, and empty space, never reproduce its UI or illustration. Preserve the recognizable engineering geometry of this exact station: yellow semi-submersible columns, complex golden-yellow truss decks and processing equipment, long lattice flare boom extending diagonally upper-left with a small realistic flame, helideck projecting upper-right, white accommodation block on the right, original CNOOC and 深海一号 nameplate/signage in their authentic places. No invented new logo, no large type. Physically plausible composite concept, do not pretend added wind farms were in the original documentary photo. Natural photographic materials and industrial detail, premium corporate editorial photography. Maintain a strong clear hierarchy: the real platform is dominant in near/middle distance, a SMALL number of realistic white offshore wind turbines form a receding distant layer and indicate renewable energy, tiny naturally-lit infrastructure is secondary. Ocean surface in foreground leads toward the platform and then into the hazy horizon; coherent water plane, correct turbine blades, convincing scale and atmospheric perspective. Wide horizontal 16:10 composition, high resolution; leave the LEFT 15-20% as unbusy deep-blue ocean/sky with low contrast, keep all main infrastructure in the center-right, the sky and water at all outer edges should coordinate with #102333 and #101d30 for smooth website integration. Not a boxed poster or full webpage; output art only with no UI, no borders, no headings, no captions, no watermark. Do not add cartoon/vector elements, floating icons, giant holograms, laser beams, space fantasy, collaged circles, oversized renewable equipment or artificial glowing ocean grids.

Direction A — DEEP BLUE FLAGSHIP. Refine the supplied photo into a cinematic but completely photorealistic blue-hour aerial view. Preserve the reference station's orientation, viewpoint and accurate details, bringing it slightly closer so the station fills about 60% of image width, centered around x=59%, with its entire flare boom and helideck in frame. Deep midnight-navy sky with a restrained dusk band just above the horizon, rich navy/teal seawater and sharp authentic warm amber working lights reflecting on softly rippled ocean. Retain visible navy detail rather than crushing shadows. Five or six slender wind turbines at realistic distances behind and to the right of the platform, diminishing naturally toward the far horizon. Elegant, solemn, confident, image-led CNOOC identity. No extra optical overlays; excellent real industrial photography with selective cinematic grading. The nearest ocean is dark and naturally textured, the platform is the visual focus, the far wind farm is a quiet light silhouette. No foreground land.
